svg.title: AREA 20
svg.desc: The Force takes the rear-left light switch as others clear the dark room. Tap red and retreat; clear turrets with a gun or Zonde. One crosses the fence and holds green to release the party. The Force may collect side-room boxes while the party clears ahead; skip for TA. Turrets guard the healing ring. If needed, the highest-HP player clears them first, then admits teammates. The last room has center traps. If uncleared, follow the right wall instead of the source’s straight red route.
